main_text.p: tiebatur, nihil ille quidem majoris rei aggredi aut moliri audebat, quod recens adhuc effet memoria devicti ab Achaiis Machanida, sed manfura diutius ac dura tyrannidis principia ponebat & fundamenta jaciebat. Reliquias enim nominis Spartani funditus delebat: eos qui opibus aut gloria majorum caeteris praestabant, solum vertere cogebat. Horum fortunas & uxores iis, qui inter reliquos eminebant, & mercenario militi dividebat. Hi autem erant homicida, effractores, vestimentorum fures, vecticularii, hoc est, parietum perfossores. Nam hoc duntaxat genus hominum, quibus propter impia facinora, & immania scelera pedem in patria sua ponere non licebat, sedulo Nabis toto undique ex orbe terrarum ad se accersebat. Horum ille patronum & regem cum se constituisset, stipatores & satellites eos sibi instituisset, in longum videlicet tempus istorum ope & impietatis sua famam & dominationem erat extensurus. Itaque praeter illa, quae jam diximus, cives in exilium pellere non contentus, id operam dabat, ne quis exulibus locus esset tutus, ne ullum perfugium securum. Alios enim percussoribus dimisis per vias occidebat, alios ab exi-evocatos trucidabat. Postremo in iis quibus habebant exules, conducti

page.notes: Top line reads "tiebatur" as the continuation of the previous page. The text "Fortunas" in the printed page appears as "fortunas" with the long s set as f-like; transcribed here as printed. Line "alios ab exi-" / "evocatos": the printed word after the hyphen is partly hidden at the line break; "exi-" is kept as printed, and the continuation has not been confirmed. "Machanida" is printed without a final s. Faint marks in the left margin near the lower lines look like show-through from the reverse page and are not transcribed. "per" at the lower right is the catchword and is kept in bottom_margin only.
